author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

Test failures in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51867#issuecomment-5876468346 showed that `L1MetPfProducer` used `edm::FileInPath` for an absolute path. Deeper look in the code showed a few additional problems
- mutable global state (via function-`static` variables)
- the path to the file to be read depending on the module construction order (via function call order dependency caused by the function-`static` variables)

These were fixed by refactoring the namespaces with free functions to classes, so that the full path is resolved once, and the JSON file is read upon construction (instead of lazy loading). This way each module's configuration fully dictates the JSON file(s) that module reads.

In addition, the type of the `JERFile` parameter of the `L1JUMPProducer` was changed from `string` to `FileInPath` to record the resolved location in the provenance.

This refactoring was assisted with AI.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2447

#### PR validation:

Code compiles. Workflow 38500.0 succeeds.
title: Refactor `L1METEmu` and `L1JIMPEmu` namespaces into classes
